1.consolidated_definition: crim. Robo violento de un automóvil mientras está ocupado. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Estos vehículos, añadió la Secretaria de Justicia, fueron obtenidos mediante carjacking, robo en el hogar y apropiaciones ilegales (Departamento de Justicia, 09-04-02)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Criminology. Violent carjacking of an occupied vehicle. Raw anglicism, commonly used. These vehicles, added the Secretary of Justice, were obtained through carjacking, home robbery, and illegal appropriations (Department of Justice, 04-09-02)
